en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a severely damaged house with collapsed wooden roof trusses and piles of bricks in the foreground. Behind it is a tall brick wall of another building. The sky is pale blue. The image is heavily overprinted with handwritten text in ink. At the top margin there is printed text with several language variants of the place name: 'Zemun. – Semlin. – Zimony.'
